subject: prd/argus-unattended-drive
statement: When a plan freezes at its merge, the drive shall trigger the plan's materialization through the planning stage's own contract — which keeps consent, idempotency, and wiring order — without a human prompt, and shall verify each created item at the goal object: it exists and carries the repo-configured automated-implementation tag.
rationale: prd:argus FR-9's behavior, unattended timing; the grant exists at tier-2
fit_criterion: live drill: a plan frozen at merge projects with no human prompt; every item verified at the goal object; a re-trigger records a no-op (UB-6)
